candidates.name: Pinned Liter SseDecoder with a UAR newline adapter

evidence.claim: Existing pinned submodule exports incremental SseDecoder; assessment of local pinned source identifies LF-only line scanning.
SSE accepts CR, LF and CRLF; local input normalization can retain the existing decoder.

risks: Adapter must preserve CRLF across chunks, byte bounds, UTF-8 and incomplete EOF handling.
No vendor or pin change authorized; compatibility remains unverified until final gate.
candidates.decision_rationale: Adapt at the native UAR transport seam; avoid replacing the provider stack to repair a framing gap.

candidates.name: eventsource-stream

evidence.claim: Registry reports version0.2.3, released2022-02-17; exact Rust Context7 match unavailable.

risks: No exact API/version or memory-bound qualification performed.
Would add a dependency and replace working framing behavior unnecessarily.
candidates.decision_rationale: Plausible general parser, but broader change than the observed gap; rejection is scope-based, not a claim of a defect.

candidates.name: eventsource-parser and official Anthropic streaming documentation

evidence.claim: Reference parser documents arbitrary chunk boundaries and CR/LF/CRLF.
Provider documentation permits future event types and asks clients to handle unknown events gracefully.

risks: JavaScript code is not directly adoptable in this Rust runtime.
Unknown top-level event tolerance must not turn malformed known events or incomplete tools into success.
candidates.decision_rationale: Use behavior and fixtures as references; do not add a JS runtime or copy a new parser wholesale.

candidates.name: Existing UAR credential v2 storage and atomic migration journal

evidence.claim: Assessment maps existing principal-keyed encrypted credential storage, explicit migration mappings, atomic copy/journal and preserved legacy source.

risks: Generic principal storage key is also consumed by sessions and durable work; changing it globally expands migration scope.
Credential ownership policy must govern all fallback seams and migration sources.
candidates.decision_rationale: Extend current host policy and migration contract; no new tenancy or credential framework.

candidates.name: Existing durable ingestion, accounting and fenced team ownership

evidence.claim: Assessment identifies durable upload/accounting eligibility, principal KB namespaces, authenticated reupload and fenced ownership recovery already in source.

risks: Healthy remote endpoint is not proof of durable storage.
Production live-agent state, backing volume and predecessor exclusion remain unverified.
candidates.decision_rationale: Improve safe diagnostics and supported recovery guidance while retaining eligibility, owner boundaries and liabilities.

build_required.need: Typed allowlisted run-binding diagnostics and manager completion observation
build_required.why_no_candidate: These encode UAR run lifecycle, authority and public error compatibility; a generic library cannot decide them.

build_required.need: Operator credential ownership/fallback policy, credential-local authority and migration preview
build_required.why_no_candidate: Must integrate current encrypted store and verified principal semantics without changing unrelated session keys.

build_required.need: Production-path fixtures, supported upgrade runbook and immutable release receipts
build_required.why_no_candidate: Evidence must exercise this runtime and its actual collaborators; an adopted framework does not supply product proof.
